evidence_quote: The purpose of this research analysis is to evaluate the impact of energy monitoring systems and energy management systems on a company's propensity to plan and/or implement energy efficiency measures.
A descriptive statistical analysis was developed based on both qualitative (number and type of EPIAs) and quantitative (energy impact of EPIAs) information.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Empirical descriptive-statistics analysis of national energy-audit data (EPIAs, savings, cost-effectiveness, payback time) assessing the impact of monitoring systems and ISO 50001 on planned/implemented energy efficiency actions. No EnPI/EnB measurement model is presented, proposed, evaluated, or characterised (no baseline, normalisation variables, functional form, or estimation approach identifiable); model terms appear only in the reference list. EnPI/EnB content is at most incidental.

paper_type.evidence_quote: energy audits in four different sectors in Italy were analysed

stage1.notes: Sectors: ceramics (tiles/bricks), plastic products, banks, retail - none in the closed continuous-process list. Large multi-sector statistical audit-database study; paper_type borderline (other vs multi-case).
